Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
Weakness.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

Extended_Description.xhtml:p: There are many variants of cross-site scripting, characterized by a variety of terms or involving different attack topologies.

Weakness.Name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
Weakness.Description: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input, but does not neutralize special elements.

Weakness.Name: Improper Input Validation
Weakness.Description: The product does not validate or incorrectly validates input that can affect the control flow or data flow of a program.
